complete_graph_review.scope: Complete saved AI graph refinement, not a new extraction/debate/reconstruction run
complete_graph_review.error_summary: Source context remains incomplete after the configured repair budget; timing verdict contradicts its explanation.
manual_findings: Source-role resolution returned no owner/actor bindings.
Relationship drafts still left the transformer implicit as owner of memory requirements and actor of generalization/document use.
Some purpose and timing remained in conditions or prose rather than the dedicated fields.

limitations: The full regression suite still has the same 34 known failures/errors; no new regression was detected.
Live model source-role judgments can omit owners/actors and can contradict their own explanation. No hardcoded answers were added to compensate.
Only the original AI test was checked live; accuracy across other topics is not established by deterministic genericity tests.
A context estimate is a resource heuristic. An oversized indivisible request fails explicitly rather than being truncated or approved.
